invariant.subject: uuid
invariant.source: 48-bit big-endian unsigned number of the Unix Epoch timestamp
invariant.relation: How UUIDv7 carries time inside an identifier

candidates: Explain how UUIDv7 incorporates time into an identifier: it contains a 84-bit unsigned number representing a Unix Epoch timestamp, stored in big-endian order. The reader should understand that this timestamp is part of the identifier itself.
- **Endpoint:** Clarify that UUIDv7 carries this timestamp within the identifier.
- Do not infer additional UUIDv7 behavior, such as ordering properties, or claim benefits beyond the timestamp representation.
